data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew yeb, meaning 'God is great'. In the Hebrew Bible, Jeb is the name of several individuals, including a son of Issachar and an idolatrous king of the Ammonites. The name Jeb carries the meaning “God is great” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
